act.name: Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014
act.source_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law protecting street-vendor livelihoods through surveys, vending certificates, relocation safeguards and grievance redress.

sections.title: Rights of street vendor.
sections.text: Section 12 states the right of a street vendor holding a vending certificate to carry on vending under its conditions.
sections.plain_language_summary: A certificate holder may vend in the specified vending zone in accordance with the certificate's terms and applicable rules or scheme.
